notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Tweaks to rooms!
Better bounce behavior when bumping into walls
Keyboard mappings should work for non-QWERTY layouts now (prompts may still appear showing QWERTY keys though) - Didn't realize this one until I switched to Colemak, sorry!

notes.title: 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug in the bounce-back after taking damage.
 Based on feedback from you, we pulled the punches a little bit in chapter 1 :-)

notes.title: 1.0.5 Patch
notes.content: Fix non-responsive button shortcut for viewing codex entries on controllers

notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch
notes.content:
Fix label on room selection screen from "rings" to "stars"
 Fix codex count on chapter complete showing 0 incorrectly
 Show button prompt on credits screen continue
 Prevent accidental exit on title screen before Start/Exit buttons are visible

notes.title: Developer Plays Ari's Journey Demo
notes.content:
Ari's Journey designer and developer, resinten, pllays through the full demo in a variety of ways:

 speedrun
 collect all stars
 fewest deaths
 (aspirational) no dashing!


Come chat and ask questions about the development, music, art, gameplay, and more!
